name: Apple Seed
source: Parvin has always lived a sheltered life, controlled by her doting if over-protective parents. This puts her at odds with her girlfriend, Roshanak, especially since Roshanak is an independent working girl who's not let her parents or anyone else dictate for her what kind of life she must live. Yet they must learn to put aside their differences if they want to survive the ever-haunting circles of life's eyes themselves.
